Instrument tag number: See HTF Pressure Instrument List (Item Numbers HC- XX)
Service: HTF - Heat Transfer Fluid
Design Temperature: 750 Deg. F
Maximum Measuring Range: See Note 1
Instrument type: Pressure Transmitter
Output signal: Resistance | 4-20 mA + HART | 500 Ohm
Manufacturer: ABB
Special Conditions: Solar radiation (DNI) up to 1,008 W/m²
The document contains specifications for pressure transmitters in the HTF Central Distribution Area and Storage/Expansion Area.
There are multiple pressure transmitters listed with tags, models, and chemical seal numbers.
The instruments are designed for HTF Vapor & Nitrogen service with a design pressure of 300 LBS and temperature of 700 Deg. F.
The sensors use piezorresistive technology with 316 SSL diaphragm and body materials, filled with silicone.
Transmitters are rated for hazardous areas (Class I, Division II) and have outputs of 4-20 mA + HART.
Special conditions include solar radiation exposure up to 1,008 W/m².

Housing: Aluminium, electrical connection: 1/2" NPT
Enclosure protection: NEMA 4, output signal: 4-20 mA + HART
Manufacturer: ABB, model numbers provided in separate sheet
Calibration required by vendor, solar radiation special condition noted
